findings.title: System Behavior and Data Buffering During Connectivity Loss
findings.summary: Both discoveries address how the system should handle connectivity drops during operations by gracefully degrading, holding or caching valid instructions, buffering reports locally, and indicating status clearly.
findings.unresolved_question: How long can the system operate on cached data during connectivity loss?
findings.rationale: These two discoveries share the same underlying issue of network disconnections and operational continuity for the driver.

findings.title: Precedence of Safety-Critical Conflicting Information
findings.summary: Safety-critical information must have clear precedence when conflicting information occurs, such as between DMI speed and trackside signs.
findings.rationale: Stands alone as a specific requirement regarding information conflict priority.

findings.title: Door Side Selection Verification and Alert
findings.summary: The system should provide visual confirmation and an audible alert if an incorrect door side is selected during station stops.
findings.rationale: Unique functional safety/operational aid for station stops.

findings.title: Precision Stopping Guidance Support
findings.summary: Potential system capability to support precision stopping via dynamic braking guides.
findings.unresolved_question: Should the system provide dynamic braking guides for precision stopping?
findings.rationale: Represents an extension candidate that impacts scope and braking system integration.

findings.title: Emergency Communications and DMI Emergency Interfacing
findings.summary: SmartRail must prioritize emergency communications and reports over all other data, backed by a clear DMI emergency stop interface that automatically reports to Control.
findings.rationale: Both cover driver-initiated emergency signaling and reporting priorities.

findings.title: Post-Journey Checklist Enforcement on DMI
findings.summary: The system needs to ensure proper train securing procedures are followed through a mandatory DMI checklist.
findings.unresolved_question: Should train securing procedures be enforced via a mandatory DMI checklist?
findings.rationale: Focuses specifically on post-journey secure-down procedures.

findings.title: Integration Between DMI and Post-Journey Reporting Systems
findings.summary: Integration is required between DMI real-time data and post-journey reporting systems regarding auto-population and driver validation roles.
findings.unresolved_question: How much auto-population happens from the DMI to reporting systems, and what is the driver's validation role?
findings.rationale: Highlights an interface and workflow gap for reporting data.

findings.title: Strict Operational Boundaries and Prohibitions
findings.summary: Drivers are restricted from performing specific actions without explicit authority, such as modifying schedules, bypassing safety interlocks, silencing critical alarms, or overriding safety systems.
findings.rationale: Enumerates core operational governance and system safety restrictions for drivers.

findings.title: External Operational Roles Interaction
findings.summary: The workflow relies on interactions with external operational roles such as Control, Signallers, Duty Managers, Shunters, Maintenance staff, and Medical personnel who provide authority, clearances, or briefs.
findings.unresolved_question: Are these external operational roles direct users of SmartRail or interfacing via separate systems?
findings.rationale: Identifies actor scope ambiguities across multiple railway personnel.

findings.title: Unified Journey Planner Platform
findings.summary: A single national platform aggregates all routes, schedules, and real-time prices from all operators to help passengers find and compare options.
findings.rationale: Core passenger journey planning platform concept.

findings.title: Transparent Fares and Multi-Operator Handling
findings.summary: Display all ticket types, terms, total cost upfront, and railcard discounts, while resolving how SmartRail handles non-integrated multi-operator ticketing and best value options.
findings.unresolved_question: How will SmartRail handle scenarios where an optimal journey involves travel with multiple operators that don't traditionally integrate their ticketing?
findings.rationale: Directly linked expectations around fare displays and the commercial complexities of multi-operator ticketing.

findings.title: Detailed Accessibility Information and Filtering
findings.summary: Integrate comprehensive, verified accessibility information for every station and rolling stock type, enabling passengers to filter by specific needs.
findings.unresolved_question: What level of granular detail will accessibility information provide (e.g., specific measurements vs. general tags)?
findings.rationale: Specific passenger requirement focused on accessibility data depth.

findings.title: Proactive Disruption Warnings and Alternatives
findings.summary: Highlight planned engineering works or long-term disruptions upfront during the planning stage and suggest suitable alternatives.
findings.unresolved_question: How frequently will engineering work schedules be updated and verified by SmartRail from all operators?
findings.rationale: Focuses on disruption management during passenger planning.

findings.title: Service and Occupancy Details
findings.summary: Display information on available on-board services like WiFi, catering, and power sockets, along with estimated train occupancy levels.
findings.unresolved_question: Will SmartRail provide predictive occupancy levels based on historical data and current booking trends, or just current real-time data?
findings.rationale: Details on-board amenities and occupancy visibility.

findings.title: Integrated Onward Travel Information
findings.summary: Provide basic information about local transport links at origin and destination stations.
findings.rationale: Expands system reach into multi-modal local transport links.

findings.title: Visual Seat Selection
findings.summary: Allow passengers to select specific seats from a visual coach layout highlighting amenities, accessible spaces, and proximity to toilets.
findings.rationale: Represents an advanced passenger booking feature affecting inventory integration.

findings.title: Special Assistance Integration
findings.summary: Provide a dedicated section within the booking process to request and confirm special assistance directly with clear confirmation messages.
findings.unresolved_question: Will the system differentiate between different types of assistance needs and tailor the request accordingly?
findings.rationale: Covers dedicated special assistance workflows for bookings.
